page.notes: Printed quotation marks („) stand at the start of each line on the left; they are typographic and only the opening mark of the passage is given. The row of quotation marks at the far right belongs to the facing page and is omitted. The catchword "bium" completes "dubium" and is given as catchword, so the text ends at "du-". Doubtful readings: "Ἰουδαίας" (marked [?]). Greek accents and breathings are copied as far as they can be made out; the Greek reads "Αρχέλαος" without accent as printed. Hyphenation follows the printed line ends.
